**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** 2025年出刊主題涵蓋:即時影片風格化(diffusion-based)、AI生成資料集、沉浸式語音驅動3D環境、AI繪畫與人類繪畫之視覺比較框架、倫理批判性文章;2025年2月刊有「Generative AI for Computer Graphics」專題,顯示期刊近期積極納入生成式AI相關主題稿件。

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** generative AI / diffusion models for graphics, data visualization, XR / VR / AR systems, HCI / user interfaces, rendering & real-time stylization, haptics, novel hardware architectures, AI ethics / critique pieces (跨學科評論性文章)

### AI-Research Notes (sources, blanks, and cross-language checks)

**Sources cited across this entry:**
- SciRev: https://scirev.org/journal/ieee-computer-graphics-and-applications/ — 0 reviews submitted (n/a for all metrics)
- http://www.letpub.com.cn/index.php?journalid=3322&page=journalapp&view=detail (>12週審稿週期；錄取率主觀評為「容易」)
- https://open.ieee.org/author-guidelines-for-artificial-intelligence-ai-generated-text/
- https://www.computer.org/csdl/magazine/cg/2025/02/11033412/27uvFrpCrjW
- https://www.computer.org/digital-library/magazines/cg/cfp-ieee-computer-graphics-and-applications
- https://www.xueshu.com/sci/44355/08.html (單盲審、初審6-8週、至少2位審稿人；引用一位投稿者：大修意見、兩個月收到一審結果、三位審稿人)
- 小木虫 muchong: https://muchong.com/bbs/journal.php?view=detail&jid=3337 — 僅2則留言(2011, 2021)，皆為影響因子數字，無審稿經驗、無退稿率、無審稿人風格描述

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **peer_review.type**: 無官方頁面明文聲明審稿制度(single/double-blind)；此欄位僅來自中文投稿社群聚合頁(xueshu.com)自述，未經期刊官方確認，故列為低信度而非直接填入positioning/policy層
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: SciRev該刊0筆評論；小木虫僅2則留言且均為影響因子而非審稿經驗；未找到任何中英文論壇對退稿率的具體數字
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: 無任何中文(小木虫/知乎/fabiaoji)或英文(Reddit r/AskAcademia)論壇貼文描述審稿人風格/文化的具體第一手敘述，僅有零散審稿週期數字，無足夠依據寫出審稿人文化敘述
- **positioning.framing_required**: 未見任何CFP或編輯聲明要求特定包裝角度(如'必須強調實務應用')，故留null而非臆測
- **ai_policy (journal-specific)**: CG&A未見獨立於IEEE機構政策之外的期刊專屬AI政策頁；本紀錄使用的是IEEE全機構2024年4月政策，非CG&A編輯部客製條款

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- SciRev (英文, query-time review database): 0 reviews submitted for this journal — all quantitative fields n/a
- 小木虫 muchong.com (中文): journal detail page found, only 2 comments total (2011, 2021), both just impact-factor numbers, zero experiential content
- 知乎 zhihu.com (中文): search returned only aggregator/SEO pages (letpub, iikx, deeredit) republishing the same >12週 review-time figure; no first-hand zhihu answer/thread found specific to this journal
- fabiaoji ifabiao.com (中文): appears only as a journal-directory listing page (投稿要求及格式模板), no experiential author reviews
- Reddit r/AskAcademia (英文): no threads found mentioning this journal by name
- xueshu.com / 学术之家 (中文, crowd-aggregated Q&A page 投稿如何提高成功率): yielded the most concrete data point — single-blind, ≥2 reviewers, one submitter's account of major-revision decision within ~2 months with 3 reviewers
- LetPub letpub.com.cn (中文, crowd-sourced author-community platform): >12週 average review speed, subjective acceptance-difficulty rating '容易' (easy), no specific reviewer-culture narrative
